source.authority: Primary saved ship-page HTML only; no battle_catalog.py or battle_engine.py facts are used.
source.textCapture: HTML div.specialAbilityTooltipContent rendered as normalized visible text, preserving tooltip line breaks.

interpretationNotes: Each source tooltip list item is stored as a distinct ability, including both distinct tooltips on each capital ship.
Source percentages remain sourceValue strings and are never converted into probabilities or fractions.
The three Detonation tooltips visibly say «Максимальное количество очков: 1001%»; the numeric meaning is explicitly UNKNOWN and source wording is retained.
catalogSupport describes source-component coverage by the existing Asterion passive catalog schema only. It makes no claim about whether Asterion runtime matches source battle mechanics.
Canonical Veyra slots in this fixture follow source identities: cruiser=Немезис, defender=Абсорбатор.
